text: Consciously complete tasks (flows). When you understand that you have done everything you wanted and were able to do, before switching to a new task, take a minute to mentally or physically complete the previous one. For example, with utmost pragmatism—close unnecessary browser tabs, clear documents from the desk, make a brief summary... Chaos on the desktop reflects chaos in the head, and in most cases this is the result of unfinished processes. Discipline and conscious completion of tasks releases a huge amount of mental energy for focused solving of new tasks, which life always generously throws up.
